blocks.text: Park Jinyoung of the K-pop group GOT7 will make a Manila stop for his first solo Asia concert tour, called CODE#, his label BH Entertainment announced. His Manila show will be held on December 5, 2026 at the FYM Hall, EVM Convention Center in Quezon City, his second stop outside of South Korea. Jinyoung will make his solo concert debut in Seoul at the Jangchung Arena on Nov. 7 and 8.
